name: ODU Big Blue Fall 2019

venue.name: Webb University Center, Old Dominion University

information: All net proceeds will go to Engineers Without Borders, a group of engineers who benefit underserved communities. Tentative Rounds: A second round of 4x4x4 Cube (Top 16) and a second round of 3x3x3 One-Handed (Top 16) will be held ONLY if there is extra time before 3x3x3 Cube Final. If there is still extra time, 3x3x3 Cube Final could be in a Head-to-Head format.
